newsitem.title: USA: Lehman names Cameron president, Canada unit.
newsitem.headline: Lehman names Cameron president, Canada unit.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it named Brad Cameron, a former mergers and acquisitions specialist at Toronto-based Gordon Capital, as managing director and president of Lehman Brothers Canada Inc.
Cameron, 39, has more than 10 years of experience in investment banking, Lehman said. Before joining Gordon, he was with RBC Dominion Securities, directing its mergers and acquisitions department.
The company was not immediately available to comment on whom Cameron was replacing.
Lehman said it established Lehman Brothers Canada Inc and opened an office in Toronto in 1995.
